Game Overview

At its heart, Mouse Escape is a animal game about guide a nimble mouse through intricate mazes, collecting cheese on the way to its burrow. With 10 beautifully crafted levels, Mouse Escape combines arcade excitement with puzzling challenges, testing reflexes and strategy. Navigate using simple controls and plan your moves wisely to avoid traps and find the quickest paths.
